SELL TAX

Keep 0.1% for liquidity

MARKETING RECEIVER

After step 1

Choose the receiver

Enter the deployed fee receiver contract. It must be deployed and verified before activation.

Enter a full 42-character Ethereum address.

The new receiver must be fee-exempt for its automatic burns to run. It applies to both buy and sell marketing fees, including pending payouts.

Each change is a separate Ethereum transaction. Your wallet will ask you to review and confirm.
